name: postUrl
label: Post URL
help: LinkedIn URL of the post to fetch. Provide this or the post URN.

name: postUrn
label: Post URN
help: URN of the post, accepted instead of the post URL. For example, urn:li:activity:1234567890123456789.

name: retrieveComments
label: Retrieve Comments
help: Whether to retrieve comments on the post

name: commentsLimit
label: Comments Limit
help: Number of comments to retrieve (max 500). Only used when Retrieve Comments is enabled

name: commentsReplies
label: Include Comment Replies
help: Whether to include replies to comments. Only used when Retrieve Comments is enabled

name: commentsSort
label: Comments Sort Order
help: Sort order for comments. Only used when Retrieve Comments is enabled

name: retrieveReactions
label: Retrieve Reactions
help: Whether to retrieve reactions to the post

name: reactionsLimit
label: Reactions Limit
help: Number of reactions to retrieve (max 1000). Only used when Retrieve Reactions is enabled
